title: GUE: Add dissector for Generic UDP Encapsulation
description:
Add a built-in dissector for Generic UDP Encapsulation (GUE) on its
IANA-assigned UDP port 6080.

GUE is specified in draft-ietf-intarea-gue-09. The draft has expired,
but the IANA port assignment stands and the Linux kernel implements GUE
as part of its foo-over-UDP (fou) tunneling support, so real-world
captures currently show up as undissected UDP.

Covered:

* Variant 0 data and control messages; data payloads are handed off via
  the "ip.proto" table, so `IPv4 → UDP → GUE → IPv4 → TCP` chains
  display naturally.
* Variant 1 (direct IPv4/IPv6 encapsulation without a GUE header).
* Extension fields as opaque bytes — the base draft assigns no flag
  bits ([GUEEXTEN] decoding is left for a follow-up).
* Expert infos for unknown variants, invalid variant-1 IP version and
  bogus header lengths.

Includes a scapy-generated capture (five packets: data with inner
IPv4/ICMP and IPv6/ICMPv6, extension field, control, variant 1) and
four test cases in `test/suite_dissectors/group_gue.py`.
`tools/check_dissector.py` and `tools/fuzz-test.sh` are clean.

+'''Generic UDP Encapsulation (GUE) tests'''
+
+import subprocess
+
+
+class TestGue:
+
+    def test_gue_header_fields(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Checks the GUE header fields of data, extension, control and
+        variant 1 packets.'''
+
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                                '-r', capture_file('gue.pcapng.gz'),
+                                '-Y', 'gue',
+                                '-T', 'fields',
+                                '-e', 'frame.number',
+                                '-e', 'gue.version',
+                                '-e', 'gue.c',
+                                '-e', 'gue.hlen',
+                                '-e', 'gue.proto',
+                                '-e', 'gue.ctype',
+                                '-e', 'gue.flags',
+                                '-e', 'gue.ext_data',
+                                ),
+                                encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+
+        assert stdout == (
+            '1\t0\tFalse\t0\t4\t\t0x0000\t\n'
+            '2\t0\tFalse\t1\t4\t\t0x8000\tdeadbeef\n'
+            '3\t0\tTrue\t0\t\t0\t0x0000\t\n'
+            '4\t1\t\t\t\t\t\t\n'
+            '5\t0\tFalse\t0\t41\t\t0x0000\t\n'
+        )
+
+    def test_gue_encapsulated_icmp(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Checks that the payload of GUE data messages is handed off to
+        the dissector for the carried IP protocol.'''
+
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                                '-r', capture_file('gue.pcapng.gz'),
+                                '-Y', 'gue && icmp',
+                                '-T', 'fields',
+                                '-e', 'frame.number',
+                                '-e', 'gue.proto',
+                                '-e', 'icmp.type',
+                                ),
+                                encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+
+        assert stdout == (
+            '1\t4\t8\n'
+            '2\t4\t0\n'
+            '4\t\t8\n'
+        )
+
+    def test_gue_variant1_direct_ip(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Checks that a variant 1 packet is dissected as a directly
+        encapsulated IPv4 packet.'''
+
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                                '-r', capture_file('gue.pcapng.gz'),
+                                '-Y', 'gue.version == 1',
+                                '-T', 'fields',
+                                '-e', 'frame.number',
+                                '-e', 'ip.src',
+                                ),
+                                encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+
+        assert stdout == '4\t10.0.0.1,192.0.2.1\n'
+
+    def test_gue_control_message(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Checks the Info column of a GUE control message.'''
+
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                                '-r', capture_file('gue.pcapng.gz'),
+                                '-Y', 'gue.c == 1',
+                                '-T', 'fields',
+                                '-e', 'frame.number',
+                                '-e', '_ws.col.info',
+                                ),
+                                encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+
+        assert stdout == '3\tControl message (type 0)\n'

commits_data.title: GUE: Add dissector for Generic UDP Encapsulation
commits_data.message:
GUE: Add dissector for Generic UDP Encapsulation

Generic UDP Encapsulation (GUE) is specified in draft-ietf-intarea-gue-09.
While the draft has expired, IANA has assigned UDP port 6080 to GUE and
the Linux kernel implements it as part of its foo-over-UDP (fou)
tunneling support, so the protocol is seen in real deployments.

Dissect the variant 0 header (version, C-bit, header length, protocol or
control type, flags), show extension fields as opaque data since the base
specification assigns no flag bits, and hand the payload of data messages
off to the dissector for the carried IP protocol. Variant 1 packets
(direct IPv4/IPv6 encapsulation) are handed to the IP dissectors directly.

The test capture was generated with scapy: five packets covering a data
message carrying IPv4/ICMP, a data message with an extension field, a
control message, a variant 1 packet and a data message carrying IPv6.

Assisted-by: Claude
